- **Acceptance criteria (ZOMBIES):**
  - Zero: Given a model reply that is only narration or a markdown fence around Phrase, When scored, Then the runner extracts the Phrase source (fences and prose stripped) and scores that, and a reply with no Phrase at all is a failed attempt with a clear `no_phrase_found` reason, not PH104
  - One: Given each of Codex, Copilot, Grok and agy, When one task is run, Then the CLI is invoked one-shot and headless with its own working flags (Codex with `--skip-git-repo-check`; Grok within its turn limit), and the result is `completed`

  - Boundaries: Given the self-check, When it runs, Then its rows go to `bench/results/self-check/` and never into `history.jsonl`, and no Done check may count them as a model
  - Interface: Given `bench/README.md`, When a new task author reads it, Then it explains the task format, kinds, holdout rule, scoring, the noise floor and how to read the results
  - Exceptions: Given a model that is genuinely unavailable (quota, auth), When run, Then it is recorded `unavailable` with the error, and the baseline run says which models are missing and why

## Reopened after the whole-team sign-off (2026-10-26)

The final sign-off was run before the ship, as Decider D8 required. Two seats FLAGGED, with evidence, and the facilitator
confirmed both from `bench/results/history.jsonl`. The card is not Done until they are fixed.

- **agy rows are not a measurement (Grok's flag).** All 8 `agy-gemini-4-argon-medium` rows are `completed` with `no_phrase_found`
  and `tokens_out` 3: three empty replies per task. The agy invocation (`--print` plus the prompt on the command line) captured
  nothing, and the runner discards stderr when the exit code is 0, so a capture failure was recorded as the model's language
  result. Fix: invoke agy so its reply is captured (check `agy --help`; a headless/print mode that writes the reply to stdout),
  and record an empty or near-empty reply (under a few characters) as `unavailable` with the reason `empty reply`, never as
  `no_phrase_found`. Rows produced by a failed capture are moved out of `history.jsonl` into `bench/results/invalid/` with a
  one-line note of why; they are not deleted and not counted.
- **Copilot is missing a task row (Codex's flag).** `copilot-default` has 7 of the 8 development tasks: no row for
  `002-write-total`. Fix: every model in `history.jsonl` has a row (completed or `unavailable` with its error) for every
  development task, and the runner fails loudly if a task produced no row.
- **Goodhart guard:** do not change any prompt or the suite to make a model pass; fix only the harness faults above.

Two new Done-when checks (checks 7 and 8 below) are red today and cannot be satisfied by fixtures: the first requires full
task coverage per model; the second fails if a model's completed rows are all empty-reply signatures.

## Reopened a second time (2026-10-26, facilitator check of the second run)

All eight Done-when checks passed, and the baseline is still not trustworthy. Evidence from `bench/results/history.jsonl`:
agy has 24 rows and 22 of them are empty replies (`tokens_out` at most 5) recorded as `completed` / `no_phrase_found`; the 8 old
invalid agy rows were never moved to `bench/results/invalid/` (that directory does not exist); and the check that was meant to
catch this only failed if ALL of a model's completed rows were empty, so a mix passed it.

What must be true (the checks below are written so a mix cannot pass):

- **An empty or near-empty reply is never a language result.** The runner records it as `unavailable` with the reason `empty reply`
  (after one retry of the call), not `completed` / `no_phrase_found`.
- **Invalid rows are moved, not hidden.** Every row produced by a failed capture (the old agy rows and the new empty ones) is moved
  to `bench/results/invalid/` with a one-line note; `history.jsonl` keeps only rows that measured a model.
- **agy must actually be captured.** Evidence from the facilitator's own runs: the headless call
  `agy -p <prompt> --model gemini-4-argon-high --dangerously-skip-permissions` returns the model's reply on stdout; the harness's
  `--print` form returned nothing. Find out why, and fix the invocation; do not tune any prompt.
- **Rows must be auditable.** Each row stores `reply_head`: the first 200 characters of the reply with secrets and home paths
  scrubbed, so a `no_phrase_found` can be told apart from a refusal, an error text or narration. (The 6 Grok and 9 Copilot
  `no_phrase_found` rows with text cannot be audited today.)
- **A model only counts if most of its runs measured it.** A model with fewer than 75% non-empty replies is reported
  `unavailable` for the baseline with its reason, instead of filling the history with empty rows.
- **Goodhart guard:** fix harness faults only; no prompt, suite or scoring change to make a model pass.

Checks 8 to 10 below replace the earlier weak check: no completed row may be an empty reply; the invalid-rows folder exists and is
non-empty; every row has `reply_head`.
